title: The First to Go
subtitle: Test your understanding of The First to Go — the opening casualty wave, NPC evaporation, and the silence before the Sky Event.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The first departures come from broadcast fear, before any sky event. Religious NPCs pixelate, true souls face shock or drop the dogma, and the marauding epilogue does not arrive.

relatedTopic.label: Return to The First to Go deep-dive

questions.question: What defines the operational timing of The First to Go casualty wave within the wider transitionary sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: It is the opening casualty wave and transpires entirely before active celestial phenomena or high-density energetic shifts.
options.rationale: This early sorting dynamic transpires entirely before the arrival of active celestial phenomena or high-density energetic shifts.

options.label: B
options.text: It begins after predatory factions open street warfare across abandoned infrastructure.
options.rationale: Higher soul family networks explicitly prohibited this development, so a gang epilogue does not open the sequence.

options.label: C
options.text: It manifests as the direct response to physical removal of the protective projection dome.
options.rationale: Removal of the protective projection dome comes after this opening wave, once the remaining populace faces the staged celestial conflicts.

options.label: D
options.text: It takes place at the same time as holographic aerial warfare projected in the upper firmament.
options.rationale: Projected holographic aerial warfare is the later Sky Event, and it begins only after the initial groups have departed.

questions.hint: Think about where this sorting sits relative to celestial phenomena.

questions.question: How does broadcast media contribute directly to physical departures during the opening stage of the Exit sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: By transmitting electromagnetic pulses that directly scramble neural pathways in the opening hours.
options.rationale: The final electromagnetic frequency shift comes last. Early deaths come from psychological tension and biological failure.

options.label: B
options.text: By sending instructions that point predatory gangs toward vulnerable urban centers and abandoned infrastructure.
options.rationale: Soul family networks prohibited the marauding trajectory, and the broadcasts carry fear and disclosure rather than raid orders.

options.label: C
options.text: By steering the populace from peak fear to peak fear until fragile vessels fail under the pressure.
options.rationale: The populace is directed from peak fear to peak fear, and broadcast systems orchestrate emotional extremes until frail vessels cease to function.

options.label: D
options.text: By projecting holographic images that strike population centers with immediate blindness.
options.rationale: Holographic aerial warfare belongs to the Sky Event, after the initial casualty wave has already transpired.

questions.hint: Think about the emotional extremes the broadcasts keep feeding.

questions.question: What specific phenomenon occurs to Religious NPCs upon the public invalidation of institutional control scripts?

options.label: A
options.text: They fall into catatonic silence while keeping their original biological structures.
options.rationale: Catatonic silence belongs to surviving organic remnants, not to constructs that vaporize into the aether.

options.label: B
options.text: They suffer acute cardiac arrest and leave physical biological remains behind for the remnants to find.
options.rationale: Cardiac rupture and biological remains belong to true souls. NPCs do not leave a body behind.

options.label: C
options.text: They undergo molecular destabilization and evaporate into pixelation dust.
options.rationale: Religious NPC vessels undergo molecular destabilization and evaporate into pixelation dust once their institutional scripts dissolve.

options.label: D
options.text: They join roving predatory factions to secure food and shelter for survival.
options.rationale: Predatory factions were prohibited, and these constructs vaporize rather than regroup.

questions.hint: Think about what a vessel with synthetic theological firmware does when the script ends.

questions.question: How do genuine incarnated souls who were bound to religious dogma react to the full exposure of multi-millennial institutional corruption?

options.label: A
options.text: They stay insulated from the broadcast shock because an inner spiritual architecture blocks it.
options.rationale: Dogma leaves these souls spiritually defenseless. The shock is not blocked by that architecture.

options.label: B
options.text: They form defense groups to protect remaining religious sanctuaries from structural decay.
options.rationale: Survivors instantaneously drop their religious frameworks. They do not organize to defend sanctuaries.

options.label: C
options.text: They dissolve into pixelation dust beside the artificial constructs through frequency matching.
options.rationale: Pixelation is the path of religious NPCs. True souls metabolize the trauma in a biological vessel.

options.label: D
options.text: They face a devastating existential crisis that ends in fatal shock, self-termination, or the immediate drop of theological beliefs.
options.rationale: Genuine incarnated souls face a devastating existential crisis: biological death, suicide, or the abrupt abandonment of their theological belief systems.

questions.hint: Think about the rupture a true soul faces when the deities fail to appear.

questions.question: What biological mechanism causes individuals with pre-existing pulmonary impairments to suffer fatal distress during early fear events?

options.label: A
options.text: Broadcast exposure lowers atmospheric oxygen and stops basic cellular respiration.
options.rationale: The distress is internal panic and a restricted diaphragm, not a change in ambient oxygen.

options.label: B
options.text: Energetic frequency shifts instantly solidify pulmonary tissue in compromised vessels.
options.rationale: The energetic flash is a later stage. Early lung deaths come from panic during the scare broadcasts.

options.label: C
options.text: Mass anxiety suppresses pranic intake and restricts diaphragm movement, producing acute asphyxiation.
options.rationale: Mass anxiety suppresses pranic intake, and emotional panic restricts diaphragm movement until these vessels enter fatal asphyxiation.

options.label: D
options.text: Respiratory channels are blocked by pixelated dust released as NPCs evaporate into the ambient field.
options.rationale: NPC pixelation is not the cause of this suffocation. The failure is panic inside an already impaired chest.

questions.hint: Think about what panic does to the diaphragm and to pranic intake.

questions.question: Why are elderly biological vessels particularly vulnerable during the opening scare broadcasts?

options.label: A
options.text: Long alignment with sovereign spiritual networks speeds their energetic dissolution into the field.
options.rationale: Sovereign grounding is what steadies a person. The elderly fail because degraded cardiovascular systems cannot take the shock.

options.label: B
options.text: Predatory factions operating across abandoned infrastructure single them out first.
options.rationale: That marauding trajectory was prohibited, so predation is not the cause of these early heart deaths.

options.label: C
options.text: An inability to decode digital signals dissolves their nerves into aetheric dust.
options.rationale: Dissolution into dust is the NPC path. Elderly organic vessels die by biological shock and heart failure.

options.label: D
options.text: Degraded cardiovascular systems cannot take the acute shock.
options.rationale: Older vessels have degraded cardiovascular systems that cannot accommodate the acute shock, and the horror induces widespread fatal heart attacks.

questions.hint: Think about the heart under sudden horror.

questions.question: What timeline modification spared incarnated humanity from predatory violence across abandoned infrastructure?

options.label: A
options.text: Municipal police kept law enforcement running through the whole collapse.
options.rationale: Municipal management is what fails in an unmitigated collapse. The spare came from soul family networks, not from police.

options.label: B
options.text: Broadcast media sent pacifying signals that removed predatory human instincts.
options.rationale: The broadcasts orchestrate fear. They do not pacify. The prohibition comes from higher soul family networks.

options.label: C
options.text: Celestial savior figures arrived at once and physically shielded the remnants from street conflict across abandoned infrastructure.
options.rationale: External savior figures are part of the dogma that collapses. Protection here is a timeline directive, not a rescue from the sky.

options.label: D
options.text: Higher soul family networks prohibited the marauding-gang epilogue and spared incarnated humanity from that degraded timeline.
options.rationale: Higher soul family networks explicitly prohibited this development, sparing incarnated humanity from the marauding epilogue.

questions.hint: Think about who closed off the degraded post-collapse path.

questions.question: True or False: Right after the first departures, the landscape is a heavy catatonic silence, and small bewildered collectives turn to shelter, food, and heat.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The post-departure environment is catatonic silence, and small bewildered collectives turn to basic logistical survival while running on pure adrenaline and profound shock.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Celebrations and street warfare are not the scene. The remnants are in shock and occupied with shelter, food, and heat.

questions.hint: Think about how the remnants behave once predatory crime has been neutralized.

questions.question: Where does the theatrical Sky Event fit within the chronological developmental sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: As the opening broadcast phase that starts the first terror loops.
options.rationale: The opening phase is scare broadcasts and biological collapse. Celestial spectacle comes later.

options.label: B
options.text: After the initial casualty wave.
options.rationale: The Sky Event occurs only after the initial casualty wave has already transpired, as projected holographic aerial warfare.

options.label: C
options.text: At the same moment as the final energetic flash.
options.rationale: The Sky Event is the intermediate theatrical phase. The energetic flash is the separate final shift.

options.label: D
options.text: After the protective projection dome has already been fully removed.
options.rationale: The Sky Event is the backdrop that leads toward removal of the protective projection dome. It does not follow that removal.

questions.hint: Think about whether the aerial display opens the sequence or follows a departure.

questions.question: Why do superficial detractors categorized as lightweights or mockers experience sudden psychological collapse during early disclosures?

options.label: A
options.text: Their brittle psychological shields lack spiritual depth, so undeniable truth breaks them.
options.rationale: Lightweights lack spiritual depth or courage, and their brittle psychological shields fracture completely when confronted with undeniable truth.

options.label: B
options.text: Their vessels are programmed to dissolve whenever a broadcast system fails.
options.rationale: Lightweights are brittle mockers, not synthetic NPC firmware that pixelates when a script ends.

options.label: C
options.text: They absorb excess pranic energy that overloads an ungrounded nervous system.
options.rationale: Panic suppresses pranic intake. It does not flood these people with extra energy.

options.label: D
options.text: They are hit by electromagnetic strikes built to purge online cynicism during the opening scare broadcasts.
options.rationale: No targeted strike is described. Their brittle psychological shields fracture when truth arrives.

questions.hint: Think about the inner structure of people whose stance was derision.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT part of The First to Go demographic casualty wave?

options.label: A
options.text: Sovereign individuals who practice autonomic regulation and conscious breathing through the terror spikes.
options.rationale: Developing autonomic nervous system control and conscious breathing practices is how a person withstands the spikes. The opening wave takes the devout, the elderly, the breathless, the suicide crew, and the lightweights.

options.label: B
options.text: Elderly vessels whose degraded cardiovascular systems cannot accommodate the acute panic.
options.rationale: The elderly are named directly, and degraded cardiovascular systems cannot accommodate the acute shock.

options.label: C
options.text: People with pre-existing pulmonary impairments who suffocate as panic restricts the breath and curtails pranic intake.
options.rationale: Lung and breath trouble is named in the opening cohort, and panic drives those vessels into fatal asphyxiation.

options.label: D
options.text: Devout religious adherents whose theological frameworks implode under the disclosures.
options.rationale: The devout religious are in the opening cohort and suffer collapse, self-termination, or the drop of their frameworks.

questions.hint: Sort each group against who actually fails in the opening scare events.

questions.question: What is the final phase of the four-stage departure sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: A media reset that restores traditional institutional control over whoever remains.
options.rationale: Institutional religion and its broadcasts are exposed as control. They are not restored as the last stage.

options.label: B
options.text: The Energetic Flash, dissolving remaining non-player constructs while true survivors enter collective stabilization.
options.rationale: The final electromagnetic frequency shift dissolves remaining non-player constructs while true survivors enter collective stabilization.

options.label: C
options.text: A kinetic bombardment that levels abandoned urban infrastructure across the plane.
options.rationale: Early mortality is not kinetic bombardment or external invasion. The last stage is a frequency shift.

options.label: D
options.text: The marauding-gang epilogue, which opens resource competition among the remnants across abandoned infrastructure.
options.rationale: That epilogue was prohibited by higher soul family networks and is not a stage of this sequence.

questions.hint: Think about the stage that follows broadcasts, biological collapse, and the aerial display.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a practice recommended for staying stable through the opening wave?

options.label: A
options.text: Emotional distance from cynical mockers and dogmatic conformists as those cohorts fail.
options.rationale: Cynical mockers and dogmatic conformists are fragile cohorts, and detachment avoids secondary trauma.

options.label: B
options.text: Conscious breathing and autonomic nervous system control when collective terror spikes.
options.rationale: Developing autonomic nervous system control and conscious breathing practices is vital when panic attacks compromised lungs.

options.label: C
options.text: Dropping religious beliefs, savior figures, and theological dependencies before the disclosures land.
options.rationale: That deconstruction is essential, because loyalty to manufactured deities brings immediate cognitive and cardiovascular collapse.

options.label: D
options.text: Stockpiling military weapons for an armed fight with predatory factions.
options.rationale: Post-departure communities are paralyzed by shock rather than besieged by violent marauders, so the preparation is life support, not an arms cache.

questions.hint: Weigh each practice against what actually steadies a person through the shocks.

questions.question: What primary assumption about mass physical mortality do the core revelations challenge?

options.label: A
options.text: The assumption that catastrophe requires kinetic bombardment or an external invasion, when the earliest deaths come from truth and psychological tension.
options.rationale: The earliest casualties collapse entirely through the exposure of truth and the weaponization of psychological tension, long before anomalies show in the firmament.

options.label: B
options.text: The belief that elderly cohorts are naturally immune to media-driven panic.
options.rationale: Elderly vessels are highly vulnerable. Degraded cardiovascular systems cannot accommodate the broadcast horror.

options.label: C
options.text: The expectation that high-density energetic shifts will arrive before the broadcast systems fail.
options.rationale: Broadcast fear drives the opening. The energetic flash is the final stage, not the first.

options.label: D
options.text: The idea that religious NPCs will die of cardiac arrest rather than evaporate.
options.rationale: That mix-up is real, but the public assumption being challenged is that mass death requires an outside attack.

questions.hint: Think about what people expect a catastrophe to look like from the outside.

questions.question: Why is the total elimination of external savior figures essential for survival during the opening phase?

options.label: A
options.text: Belief in savior figures forces an organic vessel to dissolve at once into pixelation dust.
options.rationale: Pixelation is the NPC path. A true soul who keeps the belief faces shock, not dust.

options.label: B
options.text: Savior dependencies keep people from joining the small logistical collectives.
options.rationale: The operational danger is fatal shock when the savior fails, not exclusion from a survival group.

options.label: C
options.text: Loyalty to manufactured savior figures brings cognitive and cardiovascular collapse when the disclosures land.
options.rationale: Retaining ideological loyalty to manufactured deities ensures immediate cognitive and cardiovascular collapse when full disclosures are broadcast.

options.label: D
options.text: Savior doctrines draw predatory factions to human gathering places during the collapse of municipal management.
options.rationale: Predatory factions were prohibited. They are not drawn by savior doctrines.

questions.hint: Think about what happens when a venerated protector does not appear.

questions.question: How does the collapse of Religious NPCs differ from that of true incarnated souls bound to religion?

options.label: A
options.text: Both groups join roving predatory factions once the broadcasts fail, municipal management collapses, and abandoned cities are left open to street predation.
options.rationale: Neither path is a gang. That epilogue was prohibited, and NPCs vaporize rather than regroup.

options.label: B
options.text: True souls evaporate into pixelation dust while NPCs suffer acute biological heart attacks.
options.rationale: That pairing is reversed. NPCs pixelate, and true souls take the biological and emotional rupture.

options.label: C
options.text: Both groups keep their bodies and simply fall quiet until the Sky Event ends.
options.rationale: NPCs leave no biological remains. True souls either die of the shock or sever the theological ties.

options.label: D
options.text: Religious NPCs pixelate into the ambient field with no biological remains, while true souls metabolize the shock into death, suicide, or a total drop of religious frameworks.
options.rationale: These entities undergo systemic pixelation and vaporize into the aether, while true souls face biological death, suicide, or they instantaneously drop their religious frameworks.

questions.hint: Think about firmware that ends versus a consciousness that has to feel the deception.

questions.question: What primary entry role does The First to Go fulfill within the overarching Exit process?

options.label: A
options.text: It acts as a military defense phase that mobilizes populations against celestial disruptions and holographic aerial warfare.
options.rationale: The stage is attrition and filtration, not a mobilization for battle.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a closing epilogue that clears debris after the final Energetic Flash.
options.rationale: This wave is the opening of the Exit sequence, long before the final electromagnetic frequency shift.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the early filtration that clears dogmatic, cardiovascular, and denial densities before the major energetic transmissions.
options.rationale: It serves as the initial filtration mechanism that clears the physical plane of unsustainable densities before the optical and electromagnetic culminations.

options.label: D
options.text: It builds permanent broadcast networks that hold economic stability across urban centers.
options.rationale: Broadcast media delivers the shocks that start the departures. It is not a plan for economic stability.

questions.hint: Think about what this stage clears before the later transmissions.

questions.question: What psychological dynamic drives the cohort designated as the Suicide Crew during the opening phase?

options.label: A
options.text: Acute dread.
options.rationale: Unanchored consciousnesses devoid of true spiritual orientation succumb to acute dread and willingly terminate their own incarnation.

options.label: B
options.text: Physical exhaustion from fleeing predatory gangs across urban infrastructure.
options.rationale: Those gangs were prohibited. The driver is dread at the shattering of consensus reality.

options.label: C
options.text: Direct audio orders on emergency channels commanding self-termination.
options.rationale: The broadcasts steer terror and disclosure. They do not issue an order to self-terminate.

options.label: D
options.text: Frequency overload from the sudden physical removal of the protective projection dome.
options.rationale: Dome removal is a later alteration. The Suicide Crew departs in the opening fear campaigns.

questions.hint: Think about unanchored people when social norms vaporize.

questions.question: What is the immediate consequence for true souls who physically survive the acute realization that their venerated deities never intervened in atrocities?

options.label: A
options.text: They dissolve into pixelation dust during the later Sky Event.
options.rationale: Pixelation is restricted to non-player constructs. Surviving souls remain incarnated.

options.label: B
options.text: They undergo an instantaneous psychological transformation and sever every tie to the theological frameworks.
options.rationale: Those true souls who physically survive instantaneously drop their religious frameworks and sever all ties to religious deities.

options.label: C
options.text: They transition into non-player characters running on synthetic theological firmware after the disclosures.
options.rationale: A true soul does not become an NPC. The NPC path is synthetic firmware that pixelates.

options.label: D
options.text: They demand that institutional broadcasts restore the religious programming.
options.rationale: Survivors recognize institutional religion as an engineered mechanism of control and abandon it.

questions.hint: Think about what a surviving organic soul does with the old worship.

questions.question: True or False: After the first departure wave, lawless armed gangs capture abandoned infrastructure and wage war on the survivors.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Conventional assumptions expect roving factions, but that path was closed.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Higher soul family networks explicitly prohibited this development, and predatory crime is neutralized by the frequency conditions of the transition.

questions.hint: Think about whether the degraded street trajectory was left in place.

questions.question: How does the initial departure wave prepare surviving consciousnesses for the later stages of the Exit sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: The panic, confusion, and grief of the early departures set the emotional backdrop for the celestial displays.
options.rationale: That grief establishes the emotional backdrop for the subsequent optical spectacles projected against the firmament.

options.label: B
options.text: It restores institutional control networks so authority figures can guide people through the firmament changes and the later flash.
options.rationale: Those networks are the control being exposed. They are not restored as guides.

options.label: C
options.text: It pushes the remnants into military alliances against external invaders.
options.rationale: The sequence precludes lawless warfare. Survivor activity turns to basic logistical survival.

options.label: D
options.text: It trains survivors to build physical shields against the electromagnetic flash.
options.rationale: What is primed is consciousness for the structural alterations, not a hardware shield against the flash.

questions.hint: Think about the feeling left behind before the optical spectacles begin.

questions.question: True or False: Pixelation dust from dissolving Religious NPCs is what blocks the lungs and kills people with breath trouble.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Pixelation is the NPC departure. It is not named as the substance that stops the breath.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Mass anxiety suppresses pranic intake, and emotional panic restricts diaphragm movement until compromised vessels reach fatal asphyxiation.

questions.hint: Think about the bodily path from panic to suffocation.

questions.question: True or False: The Sky Event, removal of the protective projection dome, and the Energetic Flash all come after The First to Go.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The Sky Event occurs only after the initial casualty wave has already transpired, and the trauma primes survivors for removal of the protective projection dome and the final electromagnetic frequency shift.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Scare broadcasts drive the opening wave. The aerial display, the dome removal, and the flash follow that departure.

questions.hint: Think about which spectacles wait until the opening wave has already passed.

questions.question: What distinguishes the structural architecture of Religious NPCs from true incarnated souls?

options.label: A
options.text: Religious NPCs physically survive the Energetic Flash, while true souls evaporate into the ambient field.
options.rationale: The flash dissolves remaining non-player constructs while true survivors enter collective stabilization.

options.label: B
options.text: Religious NPCs hold the spiritual grounding, while true souls depend on the broadcast programming for every later stage.
options.rationale: NPCs operate on simulated theological firmware. The grounding that survives is not theirs.

options.label: C
options.text: Religious NPCs have the stronger biological resilience, while true souls fail at once from heart collapse.
options.rationale: NPCs do not have a durable biology to fail. They vaporize. Heart collapse is a true-soul rupture.

options.label: D
options.text: Religious NPCs run on synthetic firmware with no multidimensional durability, while true souls carry an eternal architecture.
options.rationale: Simulated personas lack eternal architecture and have no multidimensional durability, so they pixelate, while true souls must metabolize the trauma.

questions.hint: Think about synthetic firmware versus a consciousness that can metabolize trauma.

questions.question: Why does practical preparation for the post-departure scene emphasize basic life support rather than tactical defense?

options.label: A
options.text: Survivors are moved at once to sanctuaries where food, heat, and shelter are unnecessary for the remnants.
options.rationale: They remain in small collectives securing shelter, food, and heat. They are not carried off the plane.

options.label: B
options.text: Tactical weapons are all rendered inoperable by the final Energetic Flash.
options.rationale: Defense is beside the point because predatory factions were prohibited, not because the flash breaks the weapons.

options.label: C
options.text: Predatory violence was neutralized, so the remnants are paralyzed by shock and need food, heat, and shelter.
options.rationale: Communities will be paralyzed by shock rather than besieged by violent marauders, so preparation turns to fundamental life support and grounding care for deeply traumatized survivors.

options.label: D
options.text: Municipal emergency services stay fully operational and handle every security threat.
options.rationale: Municipal management is what collapses in the unmitigated picture. Here, frequency conditions neutralize predation.

questions.hint: Think about what the remnants actually need once predation has been closed off.
